notes: National Rail (Darwin/OpenLDBWS) is structurally catalogued here but blocked at the account level — DARWIN_LDB_TOKEN not set. Same blocker as every other UK region packed so far.

FOUR co-equal tier-1 hub locks — Perth (PTH), Inverness (INV), Aberdeen (ABD), Dundee (DDE) — not one primary hub with secondaries. This is a structural departure from every other UK region packed so far. See docs/rest-of-scotland-d1/hazard-pack.md H6 and jim-handoff.md.

Caledonian Sleeper carries board-eligibility verdict out-reservation (compulsory berth booking) and is EXCLUDED from the board at Aberdeen, Inverness, Fort William, and Mallaig specifically — not city-wide, since it does not call at Perth or Dundee at all. ScotRail, CrossCountry, and LNER Highland Chieftain all verdict 'in' at every station they call. See lib/providers/rest-of-scotland.js.

Perth here is Perth, Scotland (PTH CRS) — NOT the existing live city Perth, Australia (lib/cities/perth/, city id 'perth'). Same printed station name, two entirely separate D1 cities/city ids. Flagged for Tim/product: no UI disambiguation string has been chosen yet.

Regional boundary vs. Glasgow/Edinburgh (Falkirk High area) is RESOLVED — docs/united-kingdom-ledger.md section 2 (Tim, 5 Sep 2026): Falkirk High is Edinburgh's boundary station. This catalog does not include it or any Central Belt station Glasgow/Edinburgh already claim.
No 'lines' array — no printed National Rail route/line map exists for Darwin, same structural fact as every National Rail-only region packed so far. Flat station list only.
Coordinates: NaPTAN RailReferences (CRS->coords) pulled 2026-09-07; 9/9 rail stations geocoded; no exceptions

13 Sep 2026 (UK station fill phase 1, docs/jim-brief-uk-station-fill-phase1.md, docs/uk-station-fill/{source,assignment,unverified}.md): National Rail catalog expanded from 9 to 147 stations — every other Darwin-verified Scottish station not claimed by Edinburgh or Glasgow (Fife, Stirling, the Ayr-Stranraer corridor beyond Ayr, the Highlands, the Borders line), per Tim's rule ('any station with an API is in'). Connel Ferry (CON, Argyll and Bute) is in the candidate dataset but Darwin returns 404 for it (closed station, see docs/uk-station-fill/unverified.md) — not shipped. Caledonian Sleeper excludeOperators is NOT extended to any newly-added station without direct evidence it calls there — several new stations (Stirling, Perth-Highland-line intermediates, Crianlarich, Rannoch, Corrour) are plausible Sleeper calling points, flagged as a follow-up candidate list in docs/uk-station-fill/assignment.md rather than guessed here.

stops.name: Perth
stops.class: hub lock — tier 1, co-equal with Inverness/Aberdeen/Dundee. Three-line junction (Highland Main Line north, Tayside line east, cross-country south). ScotRail, CrossCountry, LNER all 'in'. No Caledonian Sleeper documented here. NOT Perth, Australia (separate city id 'perth') — see notes.

stops.name: Inverness
stops.class: hub lock — tier 1, co-equal with Perth/Aberdeen/Dundee. Four-line terminus (Highland Main Line, Aberdeen-Inverness line, Kyle of Lochalsh line, Far North Line), 7 platforms. ScotRail, CrossCountry, LNER Highland Chieftain all 'in'; Caledonian Sleeper 'out-reservation', excluded from board.

stops.name: Aberdeen
stops.class: hub lock — tier 1, co-equal with Perth/Inverness/Dundee. Terminus/junction: Dundee-Aberdeen line (south), Aberdeen-Inverness line (north), 6 platforms. ScotRail, CrossCountry both 'in'; Caledonian Sleeper 'out-reservation', excluded from board.

stops.name: Dundee
stops.class: hub lock — tier 1, co-equal with Perth/Inverness/Aberdeen. Junction of three lines: Dundee-Perth (west), Dundee-Aberdeen (north), Dundee-Edinburgh (south — unresolved Central Belt boundary direction, see notes). ScotRail, CrossCountry both 'in'. No Caledonian Sleeper documented here.

stops.name: Kyle of Lochalsh
stops.class: branch terminus, west coast, Inverness-Kyle line. ScotRail only, 'in'. End-of-line, no through-running.

stops.name: Thurso
stops.class: Far North Line terminus, northernmost passenger railway station in Great Britain. ScotRail only, 'in'. No through-running.

stops.name: Wick
stops.class: Far North Line terminus. ScotRail only, 'in'. No through-running.

stops.name: Mallaig
stops.class: West Highland Line terminus (Inverness-Mallaig). ScotRail 'in'; Caledonian Sleeper calls nights only, 'out-reservation', excluded from board.

stops.name: Fort William
stops.class: West Highland Line, through-running to Inverness. ScotRail, CrossCountry both 'in'; Caledonian Sleeper calls nights only, 'out-reservation', excluded from board.
